No prior meditation experience is needed; simply relax, breathe, and allow the soundscape to guide you into a state of calm. services.name: Class
services.desc: Celebrate 25 years of FIT4MOM with a FREE community workout at City Springs! For 25 years, FIT4MOM has been the nation's leading prenatal and postnatal fitness program, supporting moms through every stage of motherhood with over 200 locations nationwide. Join us on Friday, August 28 at 10:00 AM for a special Anniversary Mega Class featuring a fun 2000s-inspired playlist, high-energy fitness, giveaways, and plenty of community. This full-body workout is designed for all fitness levels, whether you're expecting, newly postpartum, or years into motherhood. Come with your little ones or enjoy a workout on your own-children are welcome but not required. This event is free and open to all moms.

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: It’s the most magical time of the year in Sandy Springs, and everyone is invited to join the city for its annual celebration, Sparkle Sandy Springs, on Sunday, December 6. Presented by the City of Sandy Springs, this festive event will transform the City Springs District into a winter wonderland, complete with favorite holiday traditions, a glowing nighttime parade, and the lighting of both the Christmas tree and Menorah. Each year, thousands of families and visitors stroll through our festive village of glowing cottages, twinkling lights, and cheerful displays.
